text:
Marco: Heads-up 12 — SummitPay asked for a packaging option: per-endpoint caps + a guaranteed low-latency tier for a set of critical routes. They want this as a purchasable add-on in contracts.
Sofia: Quick clarify: do they want hard caps (reject excess) or soft caps (throttles + billing overage)?
Marco: Both. Hard caps on public endpoints to protect other tenants, and a paid SLA lane (reserved qps) for critical endpoints.
Devin: Engineering note: runtime supports reserved tokens but we don't map tokens to billing IDs. Billing team will need usage granularity by endpoint_id.
Priya: Suggested MVP scope:
- API flag to tag endpoint as "priority" or "capped"
- Billing export includes endpoint_id line item for pilot accounts
- Contract template with SLA and credit calculation
- Ops runbook for priority exhaustion
Kaden: Timeline check: if we keep UI minimal (no purchase flow), we can aim for 7 weeks. Self-serve purchase flow adds ~4 weeks.
Ruth: Legal asks: enumerated endpoints in the order form and explicit credit formula. They prefer a capped credit (e.g., credits <= monthly endpoint spend).
Marco: Pricing options to model: flat monthly per-endpoint reserve; qps-reservation tiers; usage-based premium per 1k requests. Which do we lead with?
Sofia: For enterprise pilots, flat reserved tier is easiest to sell/contract. For GA we can add usage-based offerings.
Devin: Technical checklist:
```
- surface endpoint_id in request logs
- qos_token param accepted at request level
- metrics labeled with endpoint_id + tier
- billing export schema: {account, endpoint_id, qty, unit_price}
```
Priya: Launch criteria proposal:
- Pilot: 3 customers, each using <= 5 endpoints in pilot
- Billing: invoices for pilot customers show endpoint-level lines
- Reliability: SLO doc & runbook published; SRE sign-off
- Legal: standard clause + credit calc approved
Kaden: Risk log:
- Accounting complexity for multi-endpoint discounts
- UI overload if customers buy dozens of endpoints
- Ops: explosion of incidents if each endpoint has own SLA
Ruth: Credit calc example to include in clause: "If monthly P95 > agreed SLA for >3 days, credit = min(1.5 * monthly endpoint fee, total charges for affected endpoint)". Need to agree multiplier.
Marco: Negotiation stance with SummitPay: pilot with reserved flat tiers + hard caps enforced. No self-serve until after pilot.
Sofia: Can we tie priority lane to Dedicated pools only? Ops prefers to limit to Dedicated to avoid contending with hosted traffic.
Devin: Good call. Enforceable via routing policy. We'll add a policy flag "dedicated_only" on the endpoint add-on.
Priya: Resource estimate: backend 3w, billing eng 1.5w, frontend (minimal) 2w, PM/legal part-time. Parallel tasks.
Kaden: Can we reuse existing invoice line_item codes? If not, accounting needs new GL mapping.
Ruth: Accounting needs GL mapping before billing pilot or credits will be delayed. Add as dependency.
billing-bot: Billing task created: https://redwood.internal/tasks/endpoint-billing-mapping-1789991110
Marco: Action items: Marco -> confirm scope with SummitPay; Devin -> spike runtime + mapping (2d); Priya -> draft launch checklist; Ruth -> draft contract clause with credit formula; Kaden -> update roadmap card.
Sofia: I'll add an entry in the roadmap board under "packaging: per-endpoint guarantees" and mark it pilot-Q2.
Marco: Thanks all. We'll push the pilot ask to SummitPay: 7 weeks for must-haves, self-serve in subsequent release. Closing for now.
